item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 27/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will bring cooler weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise over the region on Thursday. A cold front is expected to move across Guangdong in the following couple of days. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. A southerly airstream will bring showers to southern China early next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 20 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
